atAGlance: Giò thủ is head cheese-style pork terrine, usually with ear, cheek, pepper, wood ear mushroom, and banana-leaf wrapping.
whatItIs: Giò thủ is head-cheese style pork terrine made with ear, cheek, wood ear mushroom, fish sauce, and pepper, pressed into a firm sliceable roll.
howToEnjoy: Eat thin slices for the crunch of pork ear and wood ear mushroom. It is often a snack, Tết food, or side with pickles and herbs.
howLocalsOrder: Order giò thủ if you like chewy, peppery pork terrine textures. Ask what is inside if ear or head-meat texture is not for you.
worthKnowing: On Vietnamese Tết and snack tables, the texture is the story: springy pork, crunchy ear, wood ear mushroom, and pepper in one slice.
